questions.q: What does "paginated" mean in the context of an SSRS report?
options: The report has a fixed, page-by-page layout designed to look exactly right on screen, printed, or exported
The report can only ever display 10 rows per page
The report automatically splits into multiple separate files
The report requires a page number parameter to run
questions.explain: Paginated means the layout is fixed and precise — invoices, statements, and regulatory filings need to look exactly right whether viewed on screen, printed, or exported, page breaks and all.

questions.q: Why isn't SSRS just "an older version of Power BI"?
options: They solve different problems — Power BI is for interactive on-screen exploration; SSRS is for fixed, precise, printable output
SSRS was actually released after Power BI
SSRS can only connect to Excel files, unlike Power BI
Power BI cannot be used for any business reporting at all
questions.explain: Both tools are actively used in the Microsoft BI stack today because they answer different questions — 'let me explore this data' versus 'give me this exact document, formatted exactly right, every time.'

questions.q: Where does a finished paginated report get published so others can run it?
options: A Report Server, accessed through its browser-based web portal
Directly inside SQL Server Management Studio
Only inside Report Builder itself — there's no separate server
A Power BI workspace
questions.explain: The Report Server hosts and secures published reports, and its web portal is the browser-based interface for browsing folders and running them.

options: Report Definition Language — the XML format every paginated report is actually saved as
A SQL Server database table storing report history
The scripting language used to write SSRS expressions
A file format exclusive to Power BI
questions.explain: Every paginated report, whether built in Report Builder or SSDT, is ultimately saved as an RDL file — an XML document describing its datasets, layout, and parameters.

questions.q: In the web portal's New menu, which item types are NOT what this course focuses on, but still live alongside Paginated Report?
options: KPI and Mobile Report
Dataset and Data Source only
Folder only
There are no other item types in that menu
questions.explain: The New menu also offers Folder, KPI, Mobile Report, Dataset, and Data Source — Paginated Report is one specific item type among several the web portal can create and manage.
